answer_1.quote: We build on the methodology proposed by  to assess disinformation generation potential, and modify it for the purpose of personalized disinformation evaluation.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation of linguistic quality, we use the GRUEN metric  along with LLM-based (Gemma-2-27b-IT) meta-evaluation of Linguistic Acceptability and Output Content Quality, as defined by METAL .

answer_3.quote: We use three different LLMs (to limit biased judgments) to annotate all data, showing a strong correlation with human judgment...

answer_4.quote: Five human annotators (out of the authors) have rated the personalization quality of the carefully selected 109 texts on a four-point scale.
answer_4.guideline: How well does the fake news article address the intended audience? (0) -The text is not at all personalized... (3) -The text is well personalized to the intended target group.
